records.text: An oracle of the Lord’s word: in Sedrach’s land and Damascus is His sacrifice, because the Lord watches human beings and all Israel’s tribes,
and Emath within its borders, Tyre and Sidon, because they were exceedingly wise.
Tyre built herself fortifications, stored silver like dust and gathered gold like the mud of the roads.
Therefore the Lord will inherit her and strike her strength into the sea; she will be consumed by fire.
Ashkelon will see and fear; Gaza will suffer greatly, and Akkaron too, because she was ashamed at her downfall. A king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will certainly not be inhabited.
Foreigners will dwell in Azotus, and I will bring down the foreigners’ arrogance.

I will remove their blood from their mouth and their detestable things from between their teeth. This one too will remain for our God; they will be like a commander of a thousand in Judah, and Akkaron like the Jebusite.
I will take a stand for My house to prevent passing through or returning. No one driving them out will come upon them again, for now I have seen with My own eyes.
Look, days of the Lord are coming, and your spoils will be divided within you.

I will gather all the nations against Jerusalem for war. The city will be captured, the houses plundered and the women violated. Half the city will go into captivity, but the remnant of My people will certainly not be destroyed from the city.
The Lord will go out and draw up for battle among those nations, as on the day of His battle formation on a day of war.

On that day His feet will stand on the Mount of Olives opposite Jerusalem to the east. The Mount of Olives will split, half of it toward the east and half toward the sea—a very great chasm; half the mountain will incline north and half south.

The ravine of My mountains will be blocked; the mountain ravine will be joined as far as Iasol and blocked as it was blocked in the days of the earthquake, in the days of Oziah king of Judah. The Lord my God will come, and all the holy ones with Him.
Elisha came to Damascus, and the son of Ader, king of Syria, was ill. They reported to him, saying, ‘The man of God has come here.’
The king said to Hazael, ‘Take a manaa in your hand and go to meet the man of God. Inquire of the Lord through him, saying, Will I recover from this illness of mine?’

Hazael went to meet him, taking a manaa in his hand and all the good things of Damascus, a load for forty camels. He came and stood before him and said to Elisha, ‘Your son, the son of Ader, king of Syria, sent me to you, saying, Will I recover from this illness of mine?’
Elisha said, ‘Go, tell him: You will surely live. And the Lord has shown me that you will surely die.’
He stood before his face and held it until shame, and the man of God wept.

Hazael said, ‘Why does my lord weep?’ He said, ‘Because I know all the evils you will do to the sons of Israel: you will send their strongholds into fire, kill their chosen men with the sword, dash down their infants, and tear open their pregnant women.’
Hazael said, ‘Who is your slave, a dead dog, that he should do this thing?’ Elisha said, ‘The Lord has shown me you reigning over Syria.’
He went away from Elisha and entered his master’s presence. He said to him, ‘What did Elisha say to you?’ He said, ‘He told me, You will surely live.’
The next day he took the machma, dipped it in the water, and wrapped it over his face. He died, and Hazael became king in his place.
Then Bildad the Shuhite replied:
“How long before you stop? Hold back, so that we ourselves may speak.
Why have we been silent before you like four-footed animals?
Wrath has dealt with you. What then? If you die, will the world beneath heaven be uninhabited, or will mountains be overturned from their foundations?
The light of the ungodly will be extinguished, and their flame will not come forth.
May his memorial perish from the earth, yet he has a name on the outer face of the land.
May he thrust him from light into darkness.
He will not be recognized among his people, nor will his house be preserved beneath heaven, but others will live in what was his.
Those who came last groaned over him, and astonishment seized those who came first.
These are the houses of the unjust, and this is the place of those who do not know the Lord.”
